from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingCost(BaseModel):
    """Operating cost information from one company's financial report for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The company's stock/securities code if available")
    operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="Total operating costs for the period in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the costs cover, e.g., '2025 Q1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_costs: list[CompanyOperatingCost]
